trigger_condition: Customer lacks the features:teamsBotIntegration entitlement but calls create/update project setting with credential_type=ms_teams
potential_consequence: Customers without Teams Bot Integration entitlement can create/manage ms_teams integrations

trigger_condition: IntegrityError raised while creating/updating a non-MS_TEAMS setting (e.g. FK or other constraint violation)
guard_snippet: except IntegrityError as e: if request.credential_type == CredentialTypes.MS_TEAMS: raise 409 ms_teams...; else raise generic 500
potential_consequence: Client receives a misleading 'ms_teams integration already exists' error for unrelated DB failures on any credential type

trigger_condition: A project already has an ms_teams settings row when this migration runs while assistant_project_mapping still has rows for it
guard_snippet: skip op.drop_table("assistant_project_mapping") or export skipped rows to a backup table before dropping
potential_consequence: Skipped assistant-to-project teams mappings are permanently, irrecoverably lost once the source table is dropped

trigger_condition: assistant_project_mapping contains rows whose feature column is not 'teams' (schema allows any string)
guard_snippet: SELECT project_name, assistant_id FROM assistant_project_mapping WHERE feature = 'teams' ORDER BY project_name, created_at
potential_consequence: Assistant ids tagged for a different feature are silently merged into the new ms_teams settings row

trigger_condition: Operator downgrades after real ms_teams settings rows were created in production
guard_snippet: copy rows to a backup table (or emit a warning requiring confirmation) before DELETE FROM codemie.settings WHERE credential_type = 'MS_TEAMS'
potential_consequence: All ms_teams project integrations are deleted on downgrade with no path to restore them

trigger_condition: get_by_fields returns only the first ES hit; if two ms_teams rows already exist for a project (pre-index race), the second is invisible to this check
guard_snippet: use get_all_by_fields and check len(matches) to detect any pre-existing duplicate, not just the first hit
potential_consequence: A stale duplicate ms_teams row for a project can remain silently unnoticed by future singleton checks
